title: Derivative of a Quadratic from First Principles
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the derivative function f'(x) for f(x) = 3x^2 - 5x + 2 directly from the definition.

steps.title: Set up the General Difference Quotient
steps.explanation: Apply the definition of the derivative function with variable x.
steps.why: Definition of derivative as a function.

steps.title: Expand and Group Terms
steps.explanation: Expand the squared binomial and cancel opposite terms.
steps.why: Polynomial expansion clears constant and quadratic terms.

steps.title: Cancel h and Take Limit
steps.explanation: Factor out h, cancel the denominator, and evaluate at h = 0.
steps.why: Canceling h resolves the indeterminate form.
